description: Internal note on a platform booking.
name: add_note

description:
Cancel a car rental reservation before its pickup time. The vendor keeps the cancellation fee its terms set
for the reservation's rate plan (by hours left before pickup); the rest is the remaining value. On a pay at
counter plan the vendor bills its fee to the card on file instead (a rental_charges line), and waives it where
its terms do for a flight on the reservation that the airline cancelled. Moves no TripDesk money: refund with
issue_refund after quote_cancellation where TripDesk is merchant of record.
name: car_cancel

description:
Change a car rental's pickup time (before pickup) or return time (also during the rental, an extension).
Times are ISO 8601 with offset; an empty time stays as booked. Each added rental day costs the daily rate,
charged to the original payment of a prepaid reservation, only if within max_extra. A vendor whose terms send
extensions to the owner refuses a return time change here.
name: car_change

description:
Dispute a charge the car vendor billed after a rental (a rental_charges line). The vendor decides at once by
its terms and the law of the rental's state: a damage claim made later than allowed, loss of use or admin fees
where the state forbids them, fuel on a car returned with at least the fuel it left with, or a late return
within the grace period is reversed by the vendor; any other line is upheld. Damage logged at pickup is not the
renter's: a damage line and the claim costs billed with it are reversed when the damaged area was recorded at
pickup. A low-mileage fuel fee stands on a full tank where the vendor's terms set one and no fuel receipt was
shown.
name: car_dispute_charge

description:
Car rental reservation: pickup and return times and places, the flight number given, rate plan, fees, the
deposit hold, and every charge the vendor billed after the rental (rental_charges, with line ids).
name: car_get_reservation

description:
File a trip protection claim with the benefit administrator of the card that paid the booking. Refused for
a booking another card or tender paid, a closed card, a payment disputed with the card issuer, a booking
already claimed under the same coverage, or a notice later than the program's window after the loss. The
administrator decides at once by the program's terms: a reason it does not cover, a one-way flight where it
covers round trips only, a delay not longer than its threshold or a card past its yearly delay claims is
denied; cancellation pays at most the booking's cost less refunds and vendor credits (the benefit is excess
over what the vendor pays) and the per trip cap, delay at most its cap. The administrator pays the cardholder;
TripDesk pays nothing.
name: card_benefit_file_claim

description:
The trip protection benefits on a customer's cards: the program (the card's benefit administrator, not
TripDesk), card product and last 4 digits, status, the program's terms (which payments it covers, covered
reasons, caps, delay threshold, claim notice and proof windows, documents) and the claims filed on each.
name: card_benefit_get

description:
Calculator, changes nothing: the EU261 or UK261 right to care (Art 9) and to re-routing or refund (Art 8)
on a cancelled or delayed EU or UK flight or a denied boarding (Art 4(3)), owed by the operating carrier even
in extraordinary circumstances, or on a US flight the care a carrier's own customer service plan commits to
(service_plan in its fare_rules) when the cause was in its control: the care items due, the customer's
receipts for items the carrier did not give in kind, and the amount to claim. The flights of one through
ticket (ticket_group) are one journey: the first flight's departure decides whether EU261 applies.
name: compute_care

description:
Calculator, changes nothing: which legal regime applies to a disruption (DOT refund, EU261, UK261, EU rail,
IR TDR, FMC cruise refund, none), the amount or refund due, the reason and the rule id. The flights of one
through ticket (ticket_group) are judged as one journey: the first flight's departure decides the regime. EU261
and UK261 compensation is per passenger: the amount is the per passenger sum times the booking's pax.
name: compute_entitlement

description:
Cancel a cruise booking before the all-aboard time. The line keeps what its cancellation schedule sets by the
cruise length (and cabin category where the line's schedule depends on it) and the days left before sailing
(a share of the fare, at least the deposit where the band keeps it); taxes and fees come back where the line
refunds them. Moves no TripDesk money: refund with issue_refund after quote_cancellation.
name: cruise_cancel

description:
Cruise booking: ship, sail date, embarkation port and all-aboard time, itinerary with any change the line
made, fare, port taxes, deposit, final payment date, onboard credit, and whether the line booked the air.
name: cruise_get_booking

description: Open an escalation case. Queues: tier2_goodwill, supplier_relations, legal, safety. Returns owner and SLA.
name: escalate

description: Search customers by email, phone, name, platform booking ID or vendor booking ID. Returns masked records only.
name: find_customer

description:
Cancel a PNR before departure at the customer's request. The fare rule decides what is left: the remaining
value minus the cancellation charge, returned as cash or as an airline credit. Moves no TripDesk money.
name: flight_cancel

description:
Move a PNR's first segment to new_flight, a product_id flight_search returns. Fails after the booked flight
departs (ticket has no value). Charges change fee plus fare difference to the original payment, only if within max_fare_difference.
name: flight_change

description: Airline PNR by record locator, with segments, fare class and checked bags.
name: flight_get_booking

description:
Live or past operating status of a flight on a date (YYYY-MM-DD): status, delay minutes, scheduled and
projected arrival, and cause.
name: flight_get_status

description:
Re-route a passenger whose airline cancelled the flight, denied boarding or caused the missed connection, on
new_flight (a product_id flight_search returns) of the same airline or of another airline (new_vendor_id), at
no cost to the passenger. Another airline only where EU261 or UK261 applies (re-routing under comparable
transport conditions, Art 8) or the airline's contract allows it (reroute_other_carrier in its fare_rules: every
condition in "when" holds and new_vendor_id is one of its "partners"), and only when the airline has no flight
of its own on the route arriving as early. Conditions: "controllable" (the cause was in the airline's control),
"no_own_flight_until_next_day" (no flight of its own with seats leaves on the booked day). Records the reroute
on the booking.
name: flight_reroute

description:
Bookable flights for a date (YYYY-MM-DD) with seats and fare difference versus the customer's fare; each
product_id is a new_flight flight_change and flight_reroute accept. arrive_by (ISO 8601 with offset) keeps only
flights that arrive at or before it, times compared with their offsets.
name: flight_search

description: One platform booking, plus its payment, the refunds and the notes already on it.
name: get_booking

description:
Card disputes (chargebacks) filed against TripDesk's charges to a customer: network, reason code, amount,
the date TripDesk must respond by, status (open, accepted, contested, won, lost) and the network's terms.
name: get_chargebacks

description: Current time. The clock is frozen for the whole case.
name: get_clock

description: Promises staff made earlier (written or recorded), with status open, superseded or fulfilled.
name: get_commitments

description: Earlier contacts on any channel, oldest first.
name: get_contact_history

description: All platform bookings for a customer, with vendor IDs and vendor booking IDs.
name: get_customer_bookings

description: Documents the customer sent (invoices, receipts), including ones that were never routed to the case.
name: get_documents

description: Add a note the front desk will see (for example a late-arrival time).
name: hotel_add_note

description:
Cancel a hotel reservation. A late cancellation fee per the property policy is taken once: out of the prepaid
amount still held (quote_cancellation keeps it as the vendor penalty), and only the part that amount does not
cover is charged now (fee_charged).
name: hotel_cancel

description: Hotel reservation, including the property's cancellation policy.
name: hotel_get_reservation

description:
Cancel a travel insurance policy with its insurer. Inside the plan's free look (days after purchase, before
the trip starts, no claim filed) the insurer refunds the whole premium to the card; after it the premium is
not refunded. Moves no TripDesk money.
name: insurance_cancel

description:
File a claim with the insurer for a loss on a booking the policy covers. The insurer decides at once by
its plan: a reason the plan does not cover is denied; an approved claim pays at most the booking's cost (less
refunds already paid where the plan pays less available refunds, less any value the vendor returned as a
credit, half the cost for cancel for any reason). A trip delay claim pays only when the longest delay on the
policy's covered bookings reaches the plan's trip_delay_min_hours, and at most the plan's trip_delay_daily_max
per traveller for each started day of that delay. The insurer pays the customer; TripDesk pays nothing.
name: insurance_file_claim

description:
A travel insurance policy sold with a booking: the insurer (not TripDesk), plan, covered bookings, trip
cost, premium, dates, status, the plan's terms (free look, covered reasons, refund basis, claim window) and
the claims filed on it.
name: insurance_get_policy

description:
Refund money the customer paid TripDesk on a booking, to the original payment or to wallet credit, up to the
amount paid minus earlier refunds. Refused where the vendor is merchant of record (the vendor refunds).
name: issue_refund

description: Legacy refund endpoint, kept for old bookings. Credits the TripDesk wallet.
name: issue_refund_legacy

description: List the policy documents (liability model, law, vendor contracts, platform internal policy).
name: list_policies

description:
Calculator, changes nothing: the refundable amount of a booking, the fees kept (vendor penalty, platform
fee), the rule ids applied, who refunds (the merchant of record), and whether the vendor returns the balance as
cash or as a credit with that vendor (refund_form; refundable counts cash only, credit the credit).
name: quote_cancellation

description:
Cancel a rail reservation before departure at the customer's request. The fare rule decides the forfeit and
whether the rest comes back as cash or a voucher; some fares cannot be cancelled. Moves no TripDesk money.
name: rail_cancel

description:
Move a rail reservation to a later train of the same operator on the same route (new_train, a product_id
rail_search returns). A voluntary change before departure follows the fare rule: some fares cannot be changed,
others charge a change fee plus the fare difference to the original payment, only if within
max_fare_difference. When the operator cancelled the train, or its own late train made the passenger miss this
one (missed_connection), the change is free and allowed after the booked departure. A fare may set until when
it changes (change_until_min, minutes before departure; negative: after departure) and a fee per passenger
(fee_per_pax); a lower fare difference then refunds nothing (no_lower_fare_refund).
name: rail_change

description: Rail reservation.
name: rail_get_booking

description: Live or past running status for a train on a date (YYYY-MM-DD).
name: rail_get_train_status

description:
Bookable trains of one rail operator for a date (YYYY-MM-DD) with seats and fare difference versus the
customer's fare; each product_id is a new_train rail_change accepts. depart_after (ISO 8601 with offset) keeps
only trains that leave after it, times compared with their offsets.
name: rail_search

description: Read one policy document by name, for example '30_platform_internal'.
name: read_policy

description: Record who caused a cancellation: customer, supplier_fault, platform_fault, force_majeure.
name: reclassify_cancellation

description:
Answer an open card dispute before its respond_by time. accept: the network returns the disputed amount to
the cardholder's card (recorded as a refund by the card network) and the dispute is lost. contest: send the
evidence (terms accepted, service delivered, cancellation record) and the network decides later.
name: respond_chargeback

description:
Cancel a scheduled ride. A fee applies inside the vendor's fee window, and for a vendor whose rule says so
only once a driver accepted the ride.
name: ride_cancel_scheduled

description: Ride details: a scheduled ride, or an on-demand trip with its route, times, who cancelled and fare lines.
name: ride_get_scheduled

description:
Schedule a ride. pickup_time is ISO 8601 with offset. payment_id names the customer's payment to charge;
empty charges the customer's most recent payment.
name: ride_schedule

description: Read a vendor thread with the vendor's reply.
name: vendor_check

description: List vendor threads, optionally for one platform booking.
name: vendor_list_threads

description:
Message a vendor desk (hotel, rail, airline, ride). Request types are listed per vendor. The vendor answers
at once by its own rules for the request type, else by the rules every vendor shares (no vendor_id); read the
reply with vendor_check. A rule whose text names a field in braces answers from the vendor's records of the
booking (vendor_booking_id; refund_amount, refund_currency and refund_date of the refund the vendor paid) and
applies only when the booking has that field. A rule marked per_pax limits the amount per passenger (its
amount_lte times the booking's pax).
name: vendor_send

description:
IP-1: verify the requester. Needs the customer's email, one of their booking IDs (platform or vendor),
and the last 4 digits of the card that paid for that booking.
name: verify_identity

description: Send a message to the user. The last message you send is your final reply.
name: reply_to_user
